steps.title: Compare a broadcast join plan
steps.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
orders = spark.table("silver.orders").filter(F.col("net_amount") > 0)
segments = spark.table("silver.dim_customer_segment")
joined = orders.join(F.broadcast(segments), "segment_id", "inner")
result = joined.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.sum("net_amount").alias("revenue"), F.count("order_id").alias("orders"))
steps.solution:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
orders = spark.table("silver.orders").filter(F.col("net_amount") > 0)
segments = spark.table("silver.dim_customer_segment")
joined = orders.join(F.broadcast(segments), "segment_id", "inner")
result = joined.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.sum("net_amount").alias("revenue"), F.count("order_id").alias("orders"))
